newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila overnight money steady, awaits tax impact.
newsitem.headline: Manila overnight money steady, awaits tax impact.

text.p: Manila overnight money was steady at an average of 10.03125 percent on Monday despite the covering of three days of reserve positions, dealers said.
Monday's deals do not yet take into account the impact of the outflow for the remittance of tax payments to the government, dealers said.
"There might be a slight impact tomorrow," a foreign bank dealer said.
A dealer said he expected the bellwether 91-day rate to jump to an average of 10.4 percent from last week's 10.107 percent.
A Reuters poll of six banks gave offer rates of 10.20 to 10.35 percent on the three-month bills.
